title: Bowing style and lessons with Professor Fink
summary: Breaux uses the French bow, and took a few lessons from the German teacher Professor Fink though he rarely used the bow.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: What kind of a bow do you use, what they call the French style like a violin or the German where you put your hand in?
No, I used the French style. I did. A little while I did play.
Not this one. Not the German. No.

I like that from this old German professor that was teaching at Grimmauld, Fink. He died. The violin player was he? Professor Fink. Yeah, he was teaching bass over there. And I took a few lessons with him to develop my boy. I liked quite a bit but I mean I never did practice it because I didn't have no use for it. I mean the kind of music I play, I mean you don't ever have no call for no boy.
